# Paris Heating & Cooling

> Heating and cooling requests for Paris. Furnace repair covers diagnosis and repair of gas, propane, and oil furnaces, including ignition, airflow, burner, and control faults.

Email: contact@parisheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://parisheatingcooling.ca

Request locations: Paris, Brantford, Caledonia, Dunnville, Simcoe, Port Dover, Nanticoke, Ayr, Aylmer. Coverage and availability require provider confirmation.
